Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original isometric furniture sprites for a school virtual-room game. Primary request: An adjustable gym weight bench, padded black seat and long backrest, red steel frame with wide stable feet. Just the bench, no person, no barbell.
Style: finely detailed classic pixel-art furniture, crisp dark outline, modeled volume and high contrast, approximately 2:1 isometric view, orthographic camera elevated 30 degrees, not photorealistic. Intended to harmonize with existing small isometric virtual furniture.
Composition: ONE square sprite sheet with EXACTLY FOUR separate views of this SAME single object in an invisible regular 2 by 2 grid. Top-left is front/right southeast SE; top-right is front/left southwest SW; bottom-left is rear/right northeast NE; bottom-right is rear/left northwest NW. The rear views must actually show the back, not copy the front. All four views same size and grounded at the same relative height in their quadrant. Each whole object centered in its own quadrant with generous transparent padding at least 12% on all sides. No touching other quadrants, no clipping, no extra views, no captions, no borders, no grid lines. Transparent background with actual alpha, including the space between objects. No ground plane, backdrop, cast shadows extending away, watermarks, logos, people or text. Bright readable furniture design that is attractive at small scale.
